_note: The one place AI models are chosen. The website asks for a job (qi:fast, qi:balanced, qi:deep, qi:vision); the server sends it to the model and reasoning effort set here. Any job can be switched without a code change with an environment variable on the server, e.g. AI_MODEL_DEEP=anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 and AI_EFFORT_DEEP=high. Requests go through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY).

qi:balanced.use: Writing the SQL for a question, and re-asking when a check finds a problem. Accuracy matters most here, so it uses the strongest model with moderate thinking.

qi:deep.use: Hard questions: joins across tables, cohorts, retention, rolling averages, what-if, forecasts, fiscal calendars, and repairing a query that failed.

qi:fast.use: Understanding the conversation (new question or follow-up), replies in words, what columns mean, and profiling a file at upload. Strong reasoning, quicker and half the price of Opus.

qi:vision.use: Smart Insight: reading a picture of a chart. Haiku 5.5 is the Claude 5.5 model OpenRouter lists with image input.
